panels.title: Users sent 5 or more

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
) select count(*) as value from s where sent >= 5

panels.description: Five tracked emails to one person in the selected range.

panels.title: Extra morning brief on one day

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select user_id, date_trunc('day', at) as day, count(*) as n
  from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'sent' and kind = 'morning_brief' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1, 2
) select count(distinct user_id) as value from d where n > 1

panels.description: A morning brief is one a day. This counts users sent more than one on the same UTC day.

panels.title: 3 or more message emails on one day

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select user_id, date_trunc('day', at) as day, count(*) as n
  from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'sent' and kind = 'message' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1, 2
) select count(distinct user_id) as value from d where n >= 3

panels.description: Message mail waits one minute after the latest message, then sends. Three in a day is three separate bursts.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(max(n), 0) as value from (
  select count(*) as n from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'sent' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at) group by user_id
) s

select coalesce(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by n), 0) as value from (
  select count(*) as n from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'sent' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at) group by user_id
) s

select bucket, users from (
  with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
)
  select '1 one' as bucket, count(*) as users from s where sent = 1
  union all select '2 two', count(*) from s where sent = 2
  union all select '3 three or four', count(*) from s where sent between 3 and 4
  union all select '4 five to nine', count(*) from s where sent between 5 and 9
  union all select '5 ten or more', count(*) from s where sent >= 10
) b order by bucket

panels.title: Heavy days

targets.rawSql:
select day as time,
  count(*) filter (where briefs > 1) as extra_morning_brief,
  count(*) filter (where messages >= 3) as message_bursts
from (
  select user_id, date_trunc('day', at) as day,
    count(*) filter (where kind = 'morning_brief') as briefs,
    count(*) filter (where kind = 'message') as messages
  from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'sent' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1, 2
) d group by day order by day

panels.description: Users that day who got a second morning brief, or three or more message emails.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(kind, 'untagged') as email_type,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent') as users,
  count(*) filter (where type = 'sent')::float / nullif(count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent'), 0) as emails_per_user,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as users_who_clicked
from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by sent desc

panels.title: Emailed users with no click

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
) select count(*) filter (where clicks = 0)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) as value from s

panels.description: Clicks are the reliable signal. Opens include automatic privacy fetches.

panels.title: 3 or more emails, no click

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
) select count(*) as value from s where sent >= 3 and clicks = 0

panels.description: Sent at least three tracked emails in the range and never clicked one.

panels.title: 3 or more emails, no open

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
) select count(*) as value from s where sent >= 3 and opens = 0

panels.description: Open tracking misses people who block images, so this undercounts readers.

panels.title: Morning brief, never clicked

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent' and kind = 'morning_brief') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked' and kind = 'morning_brief') as clicks
  from analytics.email_events where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent' and kind = 'morning_brief') > 0
) select count(*) as value from s where clicks = 0

panels.description: Users sent a morning brief in the range who never clicked one.

panels.title: Message email, never clicked

targets.rawSql:
with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent' and kind = 'message') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked' and kind = 'message') as clicks
  from analytics.email_events where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent' and kind = 'message') > 0
) select count(*) as value from s where clicks = 0

panels.description: Users sent a message email in the range who never clicked one.

targets.rawSql:
select bucket, users from (
  with s as (
  select user_id,
    count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') as sent,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as clicks,
    count(distinct email_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as opens
  from analytics.email_events
  where user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
  group by 1
  having count(*) filter (where type = 'sent') > 0
)
  select '1 none' as bucket, count(*) as users from s where clicks = 0
  union all select '2 one', count(*) from s where clicks = 1
  union all select '3 two or more', count(*) from s where clicks >= 2
) b order by bucket

panels.title: Emailed that day, no click in the range

targets.rawSql:
with clicks as (
  select distinct user_id from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'clicked' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
)
select date_trunc('day', at) as time,
  count(distinct user_id) as emailed,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where user_id not in (select user_id from clicks)) as no_click
from analytics.email_events
where type = 'sent' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at)
group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: No click means no click anywhere in the selected range, not only on that day.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(kind, 'untagged') as email_type,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent') as users_emailed,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'clicked') as users_clicked,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'opened') as users_opened,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'clicked')::float / nullif(count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'sent'), 0) as click_share
from analytics.email_events where $__timeFilter(at) group by 1 order by users_emailed desc
select count(distinct user_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'bounced' and $__timeFilter(at)

panels.title: Users who marked mail as spam

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct user_id) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'complained' and $__timeFilter(at)

panels.title: Emailed after a bounce

targets.rawSql:
with b as (
  select user_id, min(at) as first_at from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'bounced' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1
) select count(distinct e.user_id) as value from analytics.email_events e
  join b on b.user_id = e.user_id
  where e.type = 'sent' and e.at > b.first_at and $__timeFilter(e.at)

panels.description: A send in the range after that user's first bounce in the range.

panels.title: Emailed after a spam report

targets.rawSql:
with b as (
  select user_id, min(at) as first_at from analytics.email_events
  where type = 'complained' and user_id is not null and $__timeFilter(at) group by 1
) select count(distinct e.user_id) as value from analytics.email_events e
  join b on b.user_id = e.user_id
  where e.type = 'sent' and e.at > b.first_at and $__timeFilter(e.at)

panels.description: A send in the range after that user's first spam report in the range.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from analytics.email_events where type = 'failed' and $__timeFilter(at)

panels.title: Users who bounced or reported spam

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(at,'1d'),
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'bounced') as bounced,
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where type = 'complained') as spam
from analytics.email_events
where type in ('bounced', 'complained') and $__timeFilter(at)
group by 1 order by 1
